sections.title: Needs attention

sections.title: Coverage by outcome
sections.sql: select * from v_coverage order by segment,outcome

sections.title: Buyer themes

sections.note: One deal can mention several themes. Counts are not additive or proof of cause.

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule,record
sections.note: Selected record checks, not a legal compliance determination.
